create_scalarmeter: create a ScalarMeter with a window size to track scalar values over a rolling window
use_scalarmeter_add_value: add a value to a ScalarMeter and compute its window median, average, or global average
create_trainmeter: create a TrainMeter to measure training stats like loss, top1/top5 error, and learning rate
use_trainmeter_update_stats: update training stats with top1 error, top5 error, loss, learning rate, and minibatch size
create_testmeter: create a TestMeter to measure testing stats including top1/top5 error and minimum error tracking
